paite: Aigupta gam a panpihna zong ding a hohsuk a, sakolte tung muang a, atam ziak ua kangtalaite leh ahat mahmah ziak ua sakol tungtuang mite muang a Israelte Mi Siangthou lam en lou a, TOUPA leng dongloute zaw atung uh agik hi!
heading: Pathian In Jerusalem Ahumbit Ding
english: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help, and rely on horses, and trust in chariots because they are many, and in horsemen because they are very strong, but they don’t look to the Holy One of Israel, and they don’t seek Yahweh!

paite: Dong kei mah le uh amah leng piltak ahi, thil hoih lou ahon tungsak ding a, athute akhel nawn kei ding, thil hoih lou hih mite inkuan sual ding in athou zaw ding a, khialte panpihna dou ding in athou ding hi.
english: Yet he also is wise, and will bring disaster, and will not call back his words, but will arise against the house of the evildoers, and against the help of those who work iniquity.

paite: Aigupta mite zaw, Pathian ahi kei ua, mi leltak ahi uh; huchi in TOUPA'N akhut azak hun chiang in apanpihtu pen apai ekek ding a, apanpih pen leng apuk ding a, avek un amangthangkhawm ding uhi.
english: Now the Egyptians are men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit. When Yahweh stretches out his hand, both he who helps shall stumble, and he who is helped shall fall, and they all shall be consumed together.

paite: TOUPA'N lah huchi in ka kiang ah achi ngal a, "Humpinelkai leh humpinelkai lun lai in sa akham lai in belamchingmi tamtak amah sual ding in sapkhiak in om mah le uh, a-aw uh alau kei ding ua, abil ap ziak ua akihtak tuan louh ding bang in, sepaihte' TOUPA zaw Zion tang ah amual tung a sual ding in ahong paisuk ding hi."
english: For thus says Yahweh to me, “As the lion and the young lion growling over his prey, if a multitude of shepherds is called together against him, will not be dismayed at their voice, nor abase himself for their noise, so Yahweh of Armies will come down to fight on Mount Zion and on its heights.

paite: Vasate abu tung ua alenlen bang un sepaihte' TOUPA'N Jerusalem aveng ding; veng in atankhe ding a, apaikan in ahumbit ding hi.
english: As birds hovering, so Yahweh of Armies will protect Jerusalem. He will protect and deliver it. He will pass over and preserve it.”

paite: "Israel suante aw, nakpitak a na helsansa lam uh nga nawnta un.
english: Return to him from whom you have deeply revolted, children of Israel.

paite: Huai ni in michih in amau dangka milimte, amau dangka-eng milimte, khelhna ding a amau khut a na kibawltawmte uh lah apaimang ding ua.
english: For in that day everyone shall cast away his idols of silver and his idols of gold—sin which your own hands have made for you.

paite: Huai hun chiang in Assuria mi bel, mi namsau a puksak hilou in, namsau a puksak hilou in, namsau hihpuk in a-om ding a; namsau mite a hilou in, amah agai ding; huan, namsau lak a kipan ataimang ding a, atangvalte lah siahliaumi ahong hita ding uhi.
english: “The Assyrian will fall by the sword, not of man; and the sword, not of mankind, shall devour him. He will flee from the sword, and his young men will become subject to forced labor.

paite: Huchi in asuangpi lah thil mulkimhuai ziak in amang ding a, amiliante lah chiamtehna ziak in abuaita ding, chỉ in TOUPA, ameikuang Zion a om leh, ahaltuina mei Jerusalem a om in," achi hi.
english: His rock will pass away by reason of terror, and his princes will be afraid of the banner,” says Yahweh, whose fire is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.
